It further directs viewers to a recruiting bootcamp marketed as producing an "endless flow" of ready-to-join leads and an "army" of OneCoin recruits. The central earning pathway presented is recruitment within the OneCoin compensation and distributor structure, rather than an ordinary product or independent business service.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video ties becoming a top earner and distributor to recruiting people into OneCoin and repeatedly describes building a recruit base under a compensation plan. The recruitment-dependent earning relationship is explicit in the promotion of OneCoin's compensation plan, top-earner status, and an army of recruits.
